shadows.name: floating-launcher
shadows.purpose: Separates the overlay launcher from page content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); padding: 6px 10px; font: 600 13px/1.45 system-ui; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A familiar bordered action for settings.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #868e9c); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--bg, #fff); color: var(--text, #16181d); padding: 6px 10px; font: 500 13px/1.45 system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e7ec); background: var(--bg, #fff); } .ds-search-engine { padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-soft, #eff6ff); color: var(--accent, #2563eb); font: 600 11px/1.4 system-ui; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #16181d); font: 17px/1.45 system-ui; } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Selected Result
components.description: The active keyboard selection in the result list.
components.css: .ds-result { display: grid; gap: 1px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--selected, #eef2ff); color: var(--text, #16181d); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #2563eb); font: 14px/1.45 system-ui; } .ds-result small { color: var(--text-dim, #6b7280); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Quick Search is a compact control surface that appears while the user is already doing something else. Its design must feel immediate, stable, and familiar: the query and current selection lead; context, hints, and configuration recede. This is a product interface, never a decorative SaaS dashboard or marketing page.
keyCharacteristics: Keyboard-first, with unmistakable focus and selection states.
Compact but not cramped, including at side-panel widths.
Restrained color used for action and state rather than decoration.
Familiar system typography and browser-native interaction patterns.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates action, focus, or selection. It is never decorative and should occupy less than ten percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Query Leads Rule
rules.body: No heading, badge, or helper label may compete with the launcher input or the selected result.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Internal cards, rows, and controls use borders or tonal contrast; never add shadows to make ordinary settings look important.

dos: Do keep the query, selection, and current mode visible without scrolling.
Do retain 4.5:1 text contrast and visible keyboard focus at every supported theme and width.
Do use the 4px / 8px / 12px / 16px / 24px spacing rhythm consistently.
donts: Don't make Quick Search look like a decorative SaaS dashboard, a marketing page, or a collection of nested cards.
Don't use novelty controls, ornamental gradients, glassmorphism, or excessive motion.
Don't let helper copy compete with results or allow text to overflow its container.
